title: Compactors and Deletors
summary: Enchanted materials (160 in one), the Personal Compactor that packs them as you gather, and the Personal Deletor that throws away what you don't want.

. Right-click it to choose its materials. From then on, every time you have 160 of one of them, they become one enchanted item: as you mine, chop, farm, fish or pick things up. If your inventory is full, it packs first to make room.
Also works from your inventory or a carried backpack. Items set on it are
thrown away as you gather them
, before they take a slot: dirt, gravel, rotten flesh, whatever you don't want. They still count for your collections.
It only takes stackable items, so gear can never be deleted.
Items you or someone else dropped are left alone; only fresh drops are deleted.
Named or otherwise changed stacks are never touched, by either tool.
Right-click the compactor or deletor. A small chest-style menu opens with its slots:
Click an item in your inventory
to add it. For a compactor you can click the material or its enchanted form.
Nothing moves out of your inventory; the menu only reads what you click.
The tooltip lists what it's set to. Carrying several tools adds their lists together.
Both tools come in four tiers. A higher tier holds more materials. Upgrading at the Artisan Bench keeps the materials you set.
